Nice but room for improvement
Jan 2020
We came for dinner for a special occasion and got a table by the window. The decor of the restaurant and presentation of the dishes is very good. The authenticity of some dishes (eg. Gong bao ji ding) has been changed to suit local tastes but that's fine as long as the quality remains. The only disappointment was that all 3 dishes came out warm, not hot. Not sure how long they were sitting in the kitchen before being served but we also noticed the rice bowl was cold to the touch so it's taking the temperature out of the food which was a pity. Use warm dishes and serve hot as Chinese food must be served straight from the wok.

As Good As it Gets
Aug 2019 • Business
Location at level 3 in the Viettel Building is quite inconspicuous however once there you will see all the decor reminiscent of old Hong Kong.
Selection of dim sum and main menu is also good quality and similar to HK at half the price, though it is expensive for the locals, and some of the staff can even speak Cantonese and Mandarin if you wish. 
Overall, this place is a very pleasant experience.
